wavesMove.notice: Votes, entries and wave settings move to the 6529 Network. From {freezeWeekday} {freezeTime} UTC you can't change them until {switchOnWeekday} {switchOnTime} UTC. Chat keeps working.
wavesMove.frozen: Votes, entries and wave settings are moving to the 6529 Network. You can't change them until {switchOnWeekday} {switchOnTime} UTC. Chat keeps working.
wavesMove.moved: Votes, entries and wave settings moved to the 6529 Network on {switchOnDay}. You can't change them on this site yet. Chat keeps working.
wavesMove.movedChain: Votes, entries and wave settings moved to the 6529 Network on {switchOnDay}. Your votes, poll ballots, wave REP and entries go there from this site. Wave settings can't be changed here yet. Chat keeps working.
wavesMove.movedDocuments: Waves and decisions made outside 6529.io show here once their documents reach the 6529 Network.
wavesMove.resultPending: The result due {resultWeekday} {resultTime} UTC is counted on the 6529 Network after {switchOnWeekday} {switchOnTime} UTC.
wavesMove.paused: Paused for the move to the 6529 Network.
wavesMove.pollClosed: This poll closed when the wave moved to the 6529 Network.
wavesMove.session.votesMissing: This browser's key can't sign votes, poll ballots or wave REP yet. One wallet signature adds them, with a new 30-day key.
wavesMove.chainPolls: Polls made on the 6529 Network don't show on 6529.io yet.
wavesMove.groupNamePending: This group's name shows here once 6529.io has read it from the 6529 Network.
wavesMove.newWavesClosed: New waves aren't open yet while waves move to the 6529 Network.
wavesMove.chatHistoryOneByOne: In this wave, delete your posts one at a time. Each delete is signed by your device.
wavesMove.moderatorHideRelays: Hiding a post here doesn't remove it from the 6529 Network's relays yet.
wavesMove.pollPostLocked: A post with a poll can't be edited or deleted on this site in a wave that moves to the 6529 Network.
wavesMove.onChainRefused: This wave moved to the 6529 Network, so this change can't be made on this site.
